# Big Boys Junk Removal

> Junk removal company serving Atlanta, Suwanee, and surrounding Metro Atlanta communities. Customers can price a pickup by individual item or trailer load size, review an itemized estimate, and request a pickup online.

## Contact and business facts

- Website: https://bigboysjr.com/
- Phone: (470) 660-6874
- Email: support@bigboysjr.com
- Atlanta location: 3201 Henderson Mill Road, Atlanta, GA 30341
- Suwanee location: 2317 Breton Hunt Lane, Suwanee, GA 30024
- Customer rating: 4.9 from 127 reviews, based on the supplied Google Business Profile export
- Pricing: item-based and trailer-load estimates are available through the online quote flow
- Availability: same-day service may be available and must be confirmed when booking

## Important booking note

Online prices are estimates based on the selections entered by the customer. Big Boys confirms scope, availability, and final booking details before service.
